messages:
alex: ap-southeast1 -> fabric glue started dropping connections ~1782500000, GPU pool 'asia-gpu-pool-3' shows 30% healthy nodes, pods stuck in Pending/CrashLoop backoff. Paging since qps is hitting retry storms. pinging oncall.

pagerbot: INCIDENT alert: region: ap-southeast1; symptom: backend grpc 503s and node eviction; severity: P1; routed to #eng-oncall.

sophia: on it — are we seeing full network flaps or just internal k8s kubelet churn?

alex: mostly kubelet + kube-proxy logs show ECONNRESET and long ARP caches. I can tail node logs. starting quick health check now.

mike: if ap-southeast is degraded we need to consider traffic-shift. eu-west2 has spare GPUs (~40% headroom) but quota for big instances is limited. we can do canary shift + autoscale burst.

jamie: quick commands to inspect queue: ```
kubectl get nodes -l pool=asia-gpu-pool-3 -o wide
kubectl describe pod <stuck-pod>
watch -n 2 kubectl get pods --field-selector=status.phase!=Running
```

alex: pasted output: 10 nodes NotReady, kubelet OOM events, docker 1.2s restart loops on 4 nodes. Pods backed up in default/gpu-inference-queue ~120 pending.

lisa: status check on infra side — cloud console shows 6 preemptible GPUs lost due to node eviction from host maintenance. Core network shows transient packet loss 0.8% -> 2.5% over 2m window.

sophia: short plan: (1) reduce new traffic to ap-southeast by rerouting AI inference route to eu-west2 (canary 10% -> 50% -> 100%), (2) failover reserved requests to dedicated pool if latency critical, (3) spin up 4 on-demand GPUs in ap-southeast as emergency capacity if needed. want ack from oncall.

mike: agree. we should also change retry-backoff config to avoid cascading retries during shift: set inference-client retry_policy to exponential with max_retries=2 for that route.

jamie: I'll run the canary shift. command: `redwood traffic-shift start --from ap-southeast1 --to eu-west2 --percent 10 --canary --timeout 5m`

alex: running now. logs: "shift started, 10% of stable sessions routed to eu-west2". watch for error rate changes.

sophia: monitoring dashboards: ap-southeast 99p latency spiked from 120ms -> 2.2s; eu-west2 99p currently steady 140ms. error-rate on ap-southeast down 30% after canary. good sign.

lisa: starting on-demand fleet request in ap-southeast: provisioning 4 x a2-medium equivalents. estimate ready in ~6-8 min. costwise this will burn credits but keeps tenants alive.

mike: note on quotas — if on-demand not enough, we should consider temporary placement in asia2 partner region (asia2 has different quotas). need approvals?

alex: can we avoid manual quota requests by continuing shift? if eu-west2 capacity holds we can keep shift until nodes recover. i prefer keep canary -> 50% -> 100% unless we see impact to EU customers.

jamie: bumping to 50% now. running `redwood traffic-shift increment --to 50 --wait`

pagerbot: Pagerbot note: escalation timer set for 15m. If overall P50 latency > 1s or error rate > 5% for more than 5m, auto-escalate to infra-lead.

sophia: i'm taking lead for the next 30m. alex handoff to me once on-demand nodes come up. mike you own quota/partner outreach. jamie you continue traffic-shift ops. lisa watch cost burn and update finance channel if > $1k hourly.

alex: handoff acknowledged. on-demand nodes came online at 1782500240, cluster registers 4 nodes, some pods scheduled. health improving but still 2 nodes in NotReady.

lisa: cost note: provisioning spike estimated +$650 in the first hour due to on-demand GPUs + cross-region egress. filing quick spend-tmp tag to track.

mike: partner region request made, waiting response (CSAT ticket #PR-3891). timeline unknown.

jamie: shifting to 100% now because ap-southeast recovery is slow and we can't have partial flow causing retries. `redwood traffic-shift complete --to eu-west2 --force`

infra-bot: Action logged: traffic-shift from ap-southeast1 -> eu-west2; 100% completed at 1782500300; rollback window 30m.

sophia: metrics show user-facing errors back to baseline, latency improved vs the degraded pool. we'll keep traffic in eu-west2 until we verify ap-southeast cluster stability and kubelet fixes.

alex: creating follow-up ticket: INFRA-6521 "ap-southeast1 kubelet OOM & host maintenance handling" with root cause notes and remediation plan (tune kubelet, increase node eviction thresholds, improve host maintenance drain script).

sophia: handoff: i'll be primary for incident runbook until 1782500600, mike follow after that for postmortem. tagging @oncall-lead for post-incident review. please add any customer-impact notes.

pagerbot: Incident resolved? Condition: traffic stabilized and error rates < threshold for 10m. Handlers mark resolved when follow-ups created.

alex: marking this thread as mitigated. will update INFRA-6521 with timeline and cost impact.

infra-bot: Incident MITIGATED at 1782500320. Follow-ups: INFRA-6521, COST-405 (temporary burst).

sophia: thanks team. quick retro tomorrow 10:00 to tighten pager thresholds and consider automated cross-region warmup for critical models. :thumbsup:
